messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to flip feature flag `batch_cache_v2` to 2% at 08:30 PT for a night canary. Need ops + SRE signoff. Rollout window 1h. Anyone object?

chris: No objection. What's the expected latency delta and which metrics should we watch?

maria: Expect p50 ~ +3ms, p95 should stay <= +30ms. Watch `inference.p95_latency_ms`, `token_cost_per_req`, and `inference.error_rate`. If p95 > 40ms or errors spike above 0.5% we rollback.

lee: Can we scope to the us-west-2 prod pool only and exclude any Dedicated customers? Also please set health check buckets to 5m.

carlos: Agreed on exclusion. Rollback steps if needed: `redwood-cli rollout revert --flag=batch_cache_v2` then scale down canary:
```
kubectl scale deploy/rw-infer-canary --replicas=0 -n prod
```
Also capture the canary nodes' logs before tearing down.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan saved. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-batch-rollout. Change set: commit 0b9f3c2.

oncall-sre: @maria please hold until we run a quick staging smoke at 08:05 PT (10k tokens/min for 5m). I can run the load and validate SLOs. Add a temporary alert mute window for noisy metrics.

maria: Copy. I'll pause and run staging smoke then confirm. Staging command: `scripts/load_test.sh --rps 200 --duration 300 --model=gpt-small` — output goes to /tmp/batch_v2_smoke.log.

lee: Also add a short-lived metric `cache_hit_rate` (prefix hits) to the dashboard. If it stays <40% for 10m, that should trigger an automatic revert.

chris: Can someone paste the exact flag key + console link? Need to loop in product to whitelist test accounts.

maria: Flag key: `feature.batch_cache_v2`. Console: https://console.redwood.com/flags/feature.batch_cache_v2. I'll add product@redwood.com to the canary group.

carlos: Ops checklist item: disable autoscaler override for the canary pool during the 1h window so autoscale doesn't mask latency regression.

oncall-sre: I'll add a temporary pager rule: if `inference.error_rate` > 0.5% for 5m -> page. Otherwise send slack alerts only.

maria: Final plan/times: 08:05 staging smoke -> 08:15 ops & SRE ok -> 08:30 enable 2% in us-west-2 excl. dedicated -> 08:40 quick metric check (p95, errors, cache_hit_rate) -> 09:30 widen to 10% or rollback. I'll post here when I toggle. :thumbsup:

chris: LGTM. I'll watch the dashboards and be ready to flag anomalies. (reaction: :eyes:)
